model: H coin (minus only from L to L), shift x by outgoing direction, add the departure x to a sheet initially localized at 0. Start base (0,R) or (0,L). Integer amplitude numerator divided by sqrt(2^n). No intermediate read, discard, filter or Fourier preparation.
extent: The line coordinates inject into the two rings up to every saved horizon. Define g(x) by the centred base representative on the ring. The largest |sheet position| is n(n-1)/2. The ring is large enough for the optimal circular support and transport fits to use the displayed line distances. From the origin the bounded control moves by at most one.
encoding: Direct R launch rows. The L launch was propagated independently at every horizon. Its row at (-x,-c) has the same numerical mass and cost. Reflect the full arc [s,s+2n] to [-s-2n,-s] for a valid optimum. All mass and cost numerators use the tick denominator stated in each row. Ordered independent pair numerators use its square.
two_launch_event: Two independent complete launches start from the same localized preparation with the same direction and initial sheet. Read (x,c,y) at tick n. Count ordered pairs whose terminal (x,c) agree and whose circular sheet distance exceeds 2n. The event has zero probability on any fixed common endpoint frame obeying the speed-one cone, even if the hidden frame is randomly chosen once for both launches. A separately randomized frame per launch is a different physical setting. Both unconditional and same-port event masses use denominator 4^n. Native probabilities multiply because these are two independently initialized runs.
target_marginal_relaxation: Every terminal (x,c) may choose its own translated arc of 2n+1 sheet coordinates: one definite common frame per port, independently of hidden route or random frame label. TV distance to all such laws is the sum over ports of the minimum excluded mass. Any outside mass forces that much mismatch; moving it inside each optimal arc attains equality, even keeping the base-port marginal. This is a relaxation of any actual unit-speed microscopic dynamics from one localized physical sheet.
W1_definition: When coupling only identical base ports with their native marginals, measure cyclic distance in clock cells. Nearest-site transport into the best arc gives the exact sum of the minimum mean distances. This is not transport permitting free disposal or arbitrary changes of the base port or a direct prediction for sheet-blind records.
all_horizon_positive_control: At n, take R^p L^q R and L^q R^p R, with p=floor(n/2), q=floor((n-1)/2). For final base (p-q+1,R), their prefix is a rearrangement of p positive and q negative steps. Exchanging adjacent LR to RL raises total area by exactly two. The two unique extremes are separated by 2pq, have squared mass 2^-n each for both starts, and cannot cancel. If pq>vn and the ring does not fold this separation, no radius-vn arc contains both. Thus full joint TV>=2^-n; fibrewise W1>=2^-n(2pq-2vn). For v=1 this holds at every n>=7 with sufficient ring size. These lower bounds decay; finite data alone do not give a positive limiting defect. No convergence of area/n is assumed.

optional_controlled_interferometer.relative_route_sign: s=+1 when the chosen route signs are matched. Opposite relative sign swaps outputs.
optional_controlled_interferometer.required_controls: Coherent two-path splitter, deterministic turn/hold routing and final recombination or postselection with its actual yield. Uncompute every auxiliary route tag before the recombiner.
